exposure: timing of last antenatal care visit
cohort: 1001 pregnant women from two urban informal settlements in Nairobi, Kenya, participating in a cluster randomized controlled trial
finding: Nutritional counseling during pregnancy reduced low birth weight and preterm births.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with increased odds of low birth weight (AOR=2.27; 95% CI, 1.04-4.94).
